title: Polymarket Religion and Cultural Event Markets
description: Tracks Polymarket markets matching religion + culture keywords (Pope, papal conclave, Vatican, Catholic Church, Dalai Lama, Hajj, Easter, Diwali, Yom Kippur, Hanukkah, religious leadership transitions, beatifications, religious reform). Each row reports market id, question, slug, yes_price, no_price, volume, liquidity, category, tags, end_date, and a religion_subcategory tag (christianity / islam / buddhism / hinduism / judaism / interfaith / culture). Powers the Religion & Cultural Prediction Brief: religion-related Polymarket contracts are sparse but high-edge when relevant (papal succession, religious-event timing).
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

BASE = 'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com'
LIMIT = 100
MAX_PAGES = 5

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'market_id', 'question', 'slug',
    'yes_price', 'no_price',
    'volume', 'liquidity', 'category', 'tags',
    'religion_subcategory', 'end_date',
    'condition_id', '_epoch',
]

RELIGION_PATTERNS = [
    ('christianity', re.compile(r'\b(pope|papacy|papal|conclave|vatican|catholic|christianity|christian|protestant|orthodox|cardinal|bishop|easter|christmas|lent|ash wednesday|good friday|saint|canoniz|beatif|jesuit|opus dei|methodist|baptist|lutheran|anglican|episcopal)\b', re.I)),
    ('islam', re.compile(r'\b(islam|muslim|mosque|mecca|medina|hajj|umrah|ramadan|eid|sunni|shia|imam|mufti|ayatollah|sharia|caliphate|sufism|prophet muhammad|quran)\b', re.I)),
    ('buddhism', re.compile(r'\b(buddhism|buddhist|dalai lama|lama|monk|nirvana|karma|dharma|bodhisattva|tibetan|zen|theravada|mahayana|vesak)\b', re.I)),
    ('hinduism', re.compile(r'\b(hindu|hinduism|diwali|holi|ganesh|krishna|shiva|brahman|vedic|upanishad|sadhu|swami|guru|temple|mandir)\b', re.I)),
    ('judaism', re.compile(r'\b(judaism|jewish|jew|synagogue|rabbi|torah|talmud|kosher|hanukkah|yom kippur|passover|rosh hashanah|sabbath|shabbat|israeli rabbinate|chief rabbi)\b', re.I)),
    ('interfaith', re.compile(r'\b(interfaith|religious freedom|religious liberty|atheism|secular|theology|spirituality|holy land|jerusalem religion)\b', re.I)),
    ('culture', re.compile(r'\b(holiday|festival|tradition|cultural event|new year|holy day|sacred|ritual|ceremony)\b', re.I)),
]

RELIGION_TAGS = {'religion', 'religious', 'pope', 'vatican', 'catholic', 'islam',
                  'muslim', 'jewish', 'judaism', 'buddhism', 'hindu', 'spirituality',
                  'pope-francis', 'papal-conclave', 'dalai-lama'}

def classify_religion_subcategory(question, desc, tag_slugs):
    combined = (question or '') + ' ' + (desc or '')
    for ri in range(len(RELIGION_PATTERNS)):
        sub = RELIGION_PATTERNS[ri][0]
        pat = RELIGION_PATTERNS[ri][1]
        if pat.search(combined):
            return sub
    if tag_slugs.intersection(RELIGION_TAGS):
        return 'culture'
    return 'culture'

rows = []
for page in range(MAX_PAGES):
    offset = page * LIMIT
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE + '/markets',
            params={'limit': LIMIT, 'offset': offset, 'active': 'true', 'closed': 'false'},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        markets = resp.json() or []
    except Exception:
        break
    if not markets:
        break
    for mi in range(len(markets)):
        m = markets[mi]
        if not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        question = m.get('question', '') or ''
        desc = m.get('description', '') or ''
        category = (m.get('category', '') or '').lower()
        tags_raw = m.get('tags', [])
        if isinstance(tags_raw, str):
            try:
                tags_raw = json.loads(tags_raw)
            except Exception:
                tags_raw = []
        tag_labels = []
        tag_slugs = set()
        if isinstance(tags_raw, list):
            for ti in range(len(tags_raw)):
                t = tags_raw[ti]
                if isinstance(t, dict):
                    label = t.get('label', '') or t.get('slug', '') or ''
                    if label:
                        tag_labels.append(label)
                        tag_slugs.add(label.lower())
                    if t.get('slug'):
                        tag_slugs.add(t['slug'].lower())
                elif isinstance(t, str):
                    tag_labels.append(t)
                    tag_slugs.add(t.lower())
        is_religion = False
        for ri in range(len(RELIGION_PATTERNS)):
            pat = RELIGION_PATTERNS[ri][1]
            if pat.search(question) or pat.search(desc):
                is_religion = True
                break
        if not is_religion:
            if tag_slugs.intersection(RELIGION_TAGS):
                is_religion = True
        if not is_religion:
            if 'religion' in category or 'cultural' in category:
                is_religion = True
        if not is_religion:
            continue
        prices = m.get('outcomePrices', '[]')
        if isinstance(prices, str):
            try:
                prices = json.loads(prices)
            except Exception:
                prices = []
        yes_price = float(prices[0]) if prices else None
        no_price = float(prices[1]) if len(prices) > 1 else None
        sub = classify_religion_subcategory(question, desc, tag_slugs)
        rows.append({
            'market_id': m.get('id', '') or '',
            'question': question,
            'slug': m.get('slug', '') or '',
            'yes_price': yes_price,
            'no_price': no_price,
            'volume': float(m.get('volume', 0) or 0),
            'liquidity': float(m.get('liquidity', 0) or 0),
            'category': m.get('category', '') or '',
            'tags': ','.join(tag_labels),
            'religion_subcategory': sub,
            'end_date': m.get('endDate', '') or '',
            'condition_id': m.get('conditionId', '') or '',
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values('volume', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
